articles.title: Man, 37, facing murder charge in shooting death of 26-year-old woman in Rexdale
articles.summary: A 37-year-old man is facing a murder charge after a woman was shot and killed outside a home in Rexdale early Friday morning. Toronto police say a man and a woman were having a brief interaction just before 7:30 a.m. on Arborwood Drive in the Humberwood Boulevard and Rexdale Boulevard area when shots rang out. […]

articles.title: 5 injured, 3 arrested in early morning two-vehicle crash in Etobicoke
articles.summary: Three people are in custody following an early morning crash in Etobicoke. Toronto police said the two-vehicle crash occurred on Carlingview Drive and Disco Road, west of Highway 27, just after midnight. Five people were taken to the hospital – three with serious but non-life threatening injuries, while two others suffered minor injuries. Investigators say […]

articles.title: The Lower Don Trail is reopening after years of delays — but it's not quite finished yet
articles.summary: The section of Toronto’s Lower Don Trail between the Belleville Underpass and Queen Street East will reopen on Aug. 1. The reopening follows years of delays caused by unsuitable soil conditions and weather.

articles.title: Federal government says it won't support Ontario's Billy Bishop Airport expansion plans
articles.summary: The federal government says it won't support Ontario Premier Doug Ford's plan to expand Billy Bishop Airport to allow jets to take off and land there.

articles.title: Federal government rejects Ford’s Billy Bishop airport expansion plan
articles.summary: The federal government has rejected a plan to expand Billy Bishop Toronto City Airport. Transportation Minister Steven MacKinnon issued a statement on Friday saying he would not proceed with the expansion plan suggested by Ontario Premier Doug Ford, which would have allowed the airport to accommodate larger and nosier jets. “We will always work collaboratively […]

articles.title: Italy seeks extradition of Vaughan man for mafia-related charges
articles.summary: Italian authorities are seeking the extradition of a man from Vaughan, Ont. who was convicted in absentia of belonging to a mafia-style group more than a decade ago. In a statement to CityNews, the Toronto Police Service (TPS) confirmed the arrest of 41-year-old Carlo Bruzzese. Authorities say he was taken into custody on April 22 […]

articles.title: Police investigate suspicious fire outside Richmond Hill home
articles.summary: Police are investigating a suspicious fire that took place in the driveway of a Richmond Hill home early Friday morning.

articles.title: Victim identified, suspected arrested after fatal shooting in Etobicoke: police
articles.summary: Toronto police say they have arrested a man in connection to the fatal shooting of a 26-year-old woman in Etobicoke Friday morning.

articles.title: Toronto's newest park is getting an expansion the size of 4 Canadian football fields
articles.summary: Just a year after one of Toronto's newest parks first opened to the public, Biidaasige Park is being expanded on Friday to include four more hectares.

articles.title: More than 1,000 scrap tires are piled at this Toronto auto shop. No recyclers will take them, owner says
articles.summary: A Scarborough auto repair shop owner says he has been told by the city to clear more than a thousand scrap tires from his business, but he cannot get anyone to pick them up following changes to provincial tire recycling rules.

articles.title: Burglars posing as landscapers behind string of break-ins in Durham Region: police
articles.summary: Durham Regional Police are warning residents after a string of break-ins they say were committed by suspects posing as landscapers.
